      "The execution identity does not have the permissions required for the operation.",
      "A version mismatch causes incompatible behavior between pipeline components.",
      "The operation succeeds partially but leaves the application or infrastructure in an unexpected state."
    ],

      "Stop repeated execution if it could create duplicate resources or damage production state.",

      "Compare the failing environment with the last known working configuration.",
      "Apply the smallest safe correction, rerun the relevant validation, and confirm the resulting state."
    ],
    "bestPractices": [
      "Keep all maintainable configuration in version control.",

      "Pin important tool and dependency versions.",
      "Validate changes before allowing production execution.",
      "Record useful logs and preserve evidence for troubleshooting.",
      "Test recovery and rollback procedures in a non-production environment.",
      "Document ownership, dependencies, expected results, and operational risks."

      "The execution identity does not have the permissions required for the operation.",
      "A version mismatch causes incompatible behavior between pipeline components.",
      "The operation succeeds partially but leaves the application or infrastructure in an unexpected state."
    ],
    "recovery": [
      "Stop repeated execution if it could create duplicate resources or damage production state.",
      "Capture the complete error message, timestamps, pipeline logs, and affected resource identifiers.",
      "Verify configuration, versions, dependencies, network connectivity, and permissions.",
      "Compare the failing environment with the last known working configuration.",
      "Apply the smallest safe correction, rerun the relevant validation, and confirm the resulting state."
    ],
    "bestPractices": [
      "Keep all maintainable configuration in version control.",
      "Use separate and least-privilege identities for automation.",
      "Store sensitive values in an approved secrets manager.",
      "Pin important tool and dependency versions.",
      "Validate changes before allowing production execution.",
      "Record useful logs and preserve evidence for troubleshooting.",
      "Test recovery and rollback procedures in a non-production environment.",
      "Document ownership, dependencies, expected results, and operational risks."

      "Compare the failing environment with the last known working configuration.",
      "Apply the smallest safe correction, rerun the relevant validation, and confirm the resulting state."
    ],

      "Keep all maintainable configuration in version control.",
      "Use separate and least-privilege identities for automation.",
      "Store sensitive values in an approved secrets manager.",
      "Pin important tool and dependency versions.",
      "Validate changes before allowing production execution.",
      "Record useful logs and preserve evidence for troubleshooting.",
      "Test recovery and rollback procedures in a non-production environment.",
      "Document ownership, dependencies, expected results, and operational risks."
    ],

      "Compare the failing environment with the last known working configuration.",
      "Apply the smallest safe correction, rerun the relevant validation, and confirm the resulting state."
    ],

      "Keep all maintainable configuration in version control.",
      "Use separate and least-privilege identities for automation.",
      "Store sensitive values in an approved secrets manager.",
      "Pin important tool and dependency versions.",
      "Validate changes before allowing production execution.",
      "Record useful logs and preserve evidence for troubleshooting.",
      "Test recovery and rollback procedures in a non-production environment.",
      "Document ownership, dependencies, expected results, and operational risks."
    ],

function convertLatestLesson(rawLesson: unknown): CicdTopicLesson {
  const item = rawLesson as Record<string, unknown>;

  if (!Array.isArray(item.sections)) {
    return rawLesson as CicdTopicLesson;
  }

  const sections = item.sections as Array<{
    title: string;
    content: string;
    code?: string;
    practicalNotes?: string[];
  }>;

  const textFor = (pattern: RegExp): string =>
    sections
      .filter((section) => pattern.test(section.title))
      .map((section) => `${section.title}\n${section.content}`)
      .join("\n\n");

  const allContent = sections
    .map((section) => `${section.title}\n${section.content}`)
    .join("\n\n");

  const codeContent = sections
    .filter((section) => section.code)
    .map((section) => `${section.title}\n${section.code}`)
    .join("\n\n");

  const practicalNotes = sections.flatMap(
    (section) => section.practicalNotes ?? []
  );

  const description =
    typeof item.description === "string" ? item.description : "";

  const exercise =
    typeof item.exercise === "string" ? item.exercise : "";

  return {
    overview: description || sections[0]?.content || allContent,
    purpose: textFor(/purpose|why|business value/i) || allContent,
    architecture: textFor(/architecture|component|design|structure/i) || allContent,
    workflow: sections.map(
      (section) => `${section.title}: ${section.content}`
    ),
    example: allContent,
    commands: sections
      .filter((section) => section.code)
      .flatMap((section) => (section.code ?? "").split("\n"))
      .map((line) => line.trim())
      .filter(Boolean),
    configuration: codeContent || allContent,
    failures: [
      textFor(/failure|error|troubleshoot|problem|risk/i) || allContent
    ],
    recovery: [
      textFor(/recovery|remediation|resolution|rollback/i) || allContent
    ],
    bestPractices: [
      textFor(/best practice|production|security|operational|monitoring/i) || allContent,
      ...practicalNotes
    ],
    exercise: exercise || "Review the lesson sections and complete the practical implementation steps."
  };
}

function mergeStageOverrides(
  stageId: number,
  overrides: Record<string, unknown>
): number {
  let merged = 0;

  for (const [rawKey, rawLesson] of Object.entries(overrides)) {
    if (!rawLesson || typeof rawLesson !== "object") continue;

    const separator = rawKey.indexOf("|");
    const topicTitle = (
      separator >= 0 ? rawKey.slice(separator + 1) : rawKey
    ).trim();

    if (!topicTitle) continue;

    lessons[`${stageId}|${topicTitle}`] =
      convertLatestLesson(rawLesson);

    merged++;
  }

  return merged;
}

export const stageOverrideCounts = [
  mergeStageOverrides(1, stageOneLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(2, stageTwoLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(3, stageThreeLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(4, stageFourLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(5, stageFiveLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(6, stageSixLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(7, stageSevenLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(8, stageEightLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(9, stageNineLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(10, stageTenLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(11, stageElevenLessonOverrides),
  mergeStageOverrides(12, stageTwelveLessonOverrides)
];

export const stageOverrideTotal = stageOverrideCounts.reduce(
  (total, count) => total + count,
  0
);

export function getCicdTopicLesson(stageId: number, title: string): CicdTopicLesson | undefined {
  return lessons[String(stageId) + "|" + title];
}

export const cicdTopicLessonCount = Object.keys(lessons).length;

export function buildCicdStageTopics(stageId: number): ExpandedTopic[] {
  const titles = syllabus[stageId];
  const details = context[stageId];
  if (!titles || !details) throw new Error(`Missing CI/CD syllabus for stage ${stageId}`);

  return titles.map((title, index) => ({
    title,
    overview: `${title} is a core part of ${details.tool}. This lesson explains the concept, the components involved, the inputs it consumes and the outputs that must be verified before the CI/CD pipeline proceeds.`,
    purpose: `In a production ${details.tool} workflow, ${title.toLowerCase()} helps engineers make delivery repeatable, observable and safe. Understand when this capability is required, what problem it solves and what can happen when it is configured incorrectly.`,
    architecture: `${details.architecture} This lesson focuses on the ${title.toLowerCase()} responsibility within that flow and how its result is consumed by the next stage.`,
    workflow: [
      `Identify the ${title.toLowerCase()} requirement for the ${details.tool} stage.`,
      "Verify prerequisites, tool version, permissions and environment configuration.",
      "Apply the configuration in a controlled development environment.",
      "Execute the relevant operation and capture its logs and output.",
      "Validate the result instead of assuming that a successful command means the application is healthy.",
      "Record the evidence and promote only the verified result to the next pipeline stage."
    ],
    example: `${details.example} In this lesson, examine how ${title.toLowerCase()} affects that workflow, what evidence proves it worked and which conditions should prevent an unsafe release.`,
    commands: details.commands,
    configuration: `${details.config} For ${title}, document the required settings, keep environment-specific values separate, protect credentials and validate the configuration before production use.`,
    failures: [
      `Incorrect ${title.toLowerCase()} configuration or missing prerequisites.`,
      `Insufficient permissions or unavailable network connectivity.`,
      `Incompatible tool, plugin, runtime or dependency version.`,
      "The operation reports success but its resulting artifact or runtime state is incorrect."
    ],
    recovery: [
      `Inspect the ${details.tool} logs and identify the first failing operation related to ${title.toLowerCase()}.`,
      "Verify the active account, role, permissions, endpoint and environment.",
      "Validate configuration syntax and compare it with the known-good version.",
      "Re-run the smallest safe diagnostic or test before retrying the full pipeline.",
      "Capture the corrected output and verify downstream readiness."
    ],
    bestPractices: [
      "Use version-controlled and reviewed configuration.",
      "Apply least-privilege access and never expose credentials in logs.",
      "Pin tool and dependency versions where reproducibility matters.",
      "Keep production changes observable, auditable and reversible.",
      "Promote verified artifacts and retain diagnostic evidence."
    ],
    exercise: `Create a small ${details.tool} lab for "${title}". Apply the relevant configuration, execute the listed commands, capture the expected output, deliberately reproduce one safe failure, diagnose it and document the recovery steps.`
  }));
}
